meta.title: 999 Textile
meta.description: 999 Textile develops and produces fabrics for apparel and home-textile customers, with stable processes built for repeat orders.

footer.tagline: Stable textile processes for brands and mills that order again.

home.title: Reliable cloth, woven with care
home.subtitle: We develop and produce fabrics that join the steadiness of traditional mills with modern quality control, for apparel and home-textile partners who need a supplier they can keep.

highlights.title: Stable process
highlights.body: From yarn to finished cloth, key steps stay traceable so hand-feel and shade hold from lot to lot.

highlights.title: Clear ranges
highlights.body: Production is organized around cotton, performance, and home textiles, so new series can be added without rebuilding the catalog.

highlights.title: Repeat supply
highlights.body: We work with brands and garment factories on lead time, communication, and reorders, not one-off shipments.

about.title: About
about.description: 999 Textile supplies fabrics for apparel and home textiles. Shop-floor experience is written into standards, so each bulk lot stays close to the sample a customer has already approved.

points.title: From sample to bulk
points.body: Sampling, approval, and production are managed in stages, so color, weight, and width shift less when an order scales up.

points.title: Quality before volume
points.body: Inspection records stay with the lot. Cloth that fails is handled before it leaves, not in the customer’s next process.

points.title: Built for ongoing orders
points.body: Pages and the product catalog are structured so a new series can be added later without changing the site’s shape.

products.title: Products
products.description: These are the starting ranges. Specifications, color cards, and stock details can be added later as their own pages.

items.name: Cotton fabrics
items.summary: Cotton and cotton blends for shirting, casualwear, and foundational garments.

items.name: Performance fabrics
items.summary: Developed around breathability, structure, and easy care for uniforms and outdoor use.

items.name: Home textiles
items.summary: Bedding and soft-furnishing cloth, with stable width, colorfastness, and patterns that can be reordered.
